item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent Grid helping secure AI agent communications
item.description:
Agent Grid is now in public preview for supported Azure environments. It adds identity-based Zero Trust network security so security teams can centrally govern communication between agents, models, tools, and external services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: ​​​​​​​​What’s new in Microsoft Security: September 2026​​
item.description:
Microsoft Security’s September 2026 update focuses on discovering and controlling local AI agents, extending Zero Trust controls to agent traffic, and improving SOC foundational capabilities.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
